description: This file defines the KubeRenderer class, which implements the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface for rendering 3D graphics using OpenGL ES in an Android application. It manages rendering a scene involving a 'world' object and handles surface changes, frame drawing, and animation callbacks.

classes.name: KubeRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that implements the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface to handle drawing and updating a 3D scene using OpenGL ES in an Android environment.

methods.name: KubeRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with a world object and an optional animation callback.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Called to render a frame; clears the screen and draws the 3D scene with current transformations.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the surface size and updates the viewport and projection matrix accordingly.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initial setup for the rendering surface; currently does nothing.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle for the scene.
